summary: Conway Research's Bark 3.0, a fine-tune of NVIDIA's Parakeet: accurate English speech-to-text with word timestamps, on the CPU at about 30 times real time. Bark 3.0 (163 MB) downloads on first use; Plus, Clean (no "um"s or false starts) and Pro download only if you pick them.
author: Subtitld
license: Apache-2.0 (add-on); CC-BY-4.0 (Bark 3.0 models by Conway Research, derived from NVIDIA parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3)

models.display_name: Bark 3.0 Clean (0.6B, drops fillers and false starts)

fields.label: Model

options.label: Bark 3.0 Plus: 180 MB, a little more accurate
Bark 3.0 Clean: 179 MB, leaves out fillers (um, uh) and false starts
Bark 3.0 Pro: 1.25 GB, the most accurate

fields.help: Each model downloads once, the first time you use it, and is then prepared for this computer (about half a minute). Prepared, each takes about 650 MB of disk; all run at the same speed.

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: 0 picks half the logical processors, at most 8.

fields.label: One cue per sentence
fields.help: On: one subtitle per sentence, however long. Off: a long sentence is split into subtitles of about two lines or 7 seconds at most.
